title: The pinned sandbox image's die messages still tell operators to run 'tk factory setup'
body: image/common.sh:157,164,174,428 die with "run 'tk factory setup'" on gateway config failures, and image/Dockerfile's comments name `tk factory deploy` as the deployer — the same verbatim-port defect ogv fixed, in a tree ticks owns and this repository vendors pinned (never edit image/ here). An operator hand-starting the image, or reading a sandbox boot failure, is pointed at a binary ticfac replaced. The fix belongs in ticks (its internal/sandbox suite runs the same scripts), followed by a sandbox.pin.json ref bump and `go run ./cmd/sandbox sync` here.
